pr.body:
## Summary
- Classify every keeper skill and hook as L0 (standalone) or L0.5 (requires CLI or fleet) with per-item evidence.
- Deliver `templates/plugin/l0_membership.json` — the authoritative manifest for the signed plugin (CS-107).
- Add a CI-runnable pytest assertion that every L0-classified item contains no fleet/MCP/localhost probes.

## Scope
Series: DMX-COLDSTART. Risk: MED. Wave: 0 (entry point, no deps).

## Validation
Run packet validation commands and capture proof under `proof/TP-DMX-COLDSTART-L0-DEP-AUDIT-100/PROOF.json`.

## NOT_RUN
List any skipped live-fleet, credential, or supervisor-gated checks explicitly.

steps.task: Inspect repo truth before editing. Read every file in .claude/commands/dx/ (18 .md files: backlinks.md, block.md, blocked.md, cancel.md, complete.md, complete-tree.md, context.md, depends.md, implement.md, next.md, note.md, notes.md, preview.md, reopen.md, resume.md, search.md, start.md, tree.md). Read every hook in .claude/hooks/ (mcp_health_probe.py, session_lifecycle.py, save_context.sh, check_energy.sh, dcp_surface_guard.py, dcp_denylist_nudge.py, orchestrator_enforcement.py, orchestrator_post_edit_nudge.py, orchestrator_session_start.py, orchestrator_subagent_protocol.py, proof_tracking_guard.py, prompt_analyzer.py, track_file_edit.sh, log_progress.sh). Read .claude/commands/research*.md, implement.md, plan.md, plan-tasks.md, plan-slice.md. For each item grep for: task-orchestrator references (mcp__task-orchestrator, advance_item, claim_item), localhost or port probes (curl http://localhost, socket.connect, requests.get), docker calls, conport calls (mcp__conport__), fleet-service names (redis, qdrant, postgres, serena). Record findings per item with line evidence. Identify templates/plugin/ directory (exists as templates/plugin/routing.yaml and skills/ subdirectory; no l0_membership.json yet). Verify tests/coldstart/ exists (created by earlier packets OR create __init__.py here).
validation: Every keeper skill and hook has been read and its fleet/MCP/localhost dependencies identified or confirmed absent.
Items with mcp__task-orchestrator or localhost probes are recorded as L0.5 with specific line evidence.
Items with no fleet calls are recorded as L0 (standalone) candidates.
Any ambiguous items (e.g., fail-open fleet probes) are marked UNKNOWN pending the test assertion.
The planned diff is confirmed to stay within the packet allowlist.

steps.task: Author `templates/plugin/l0_membership.json`. Schema: { "version": "1.0", "generated": "<ISO date>", "items": [ { "id": "<skill-or-hook-name>", "type": "skill" | "hook", "path": "<relative path>", "tier": "L0" | "L0.5", "evidence": [ "<grep finding or 'no fleet calls found'>" ], "fleet_deps": [ "<mcp-tool or service name>" ] } ] }. Classify all 18 dx/ commands, 14 hooks, and the research/plan/implement commands. L0 criteria: no mcp__task-orchestrator calls, no mcp__conport__ calls requiring a running fleet, no localhost port probes, no docker subprocess calls, no unconditional calls to fleet services. L0.5 criteria: any of the above present without a verified fail-open path. Hooks with fail-open guards (e.g., dcp_surface_guard.py, proof_tracking_guard.py that fail open when fleet absent) may still be L0 if the guard is verified in tests. Record each guard pattern as evidence.
requirements: Every item in the manifest must have at least one non-empty evidence string from actual file inspection.
No item classified L0 may have an unguarded fleet/MCP call (absence of guard = L0.5).
Fleet-coupled items that ship with a hard-degrade path (probe → no-op + message) may be classified L0 only if the degrade path is verified by tests/coldstart/test_l0_membership.py.
The manifest must be valid JSON; use python -m json.tool to verify before committing.
validation: Every item listed in the manifest corresponds to a real file in the repo (no invented paths).
No L0 item has an unguarded mcp__task-orchestrator, mcp__conport__, localhost probe, or docker call in its source.

steps.task: Write tests and docs. (a) tests/coldstart/__init__.py: create if not already present (may exist after CS-101). (b) tests/coldstart/test_l0_membership.py: load templates/plugin/l0_membership.json; assert every item exists on disk; for every L0-classified item, grep its source file for the fleet-call patterns (mcp__task-orchestrator, mcp__conport__, localhost, docker, requests.get.*localhost, socket.connect) and assert the patterns are absent OR that every match is inside a fail-open guard block (guard_pattern = 'except', 'if.*not.*available', 'fail_open'); test must be runnable with `pytest -q` with no fleet running. (c) docs/02-how-to/l0-dependency-audit.md: document the L0/L0.5 criteria, how to re-run the audit when skills/hooks change, and how to update the manifest. (d) proof/TP-DMX-COLDSTART-L0-DEP-AUDIT-100/PROOF.json: commands, exit codes, diff scope, residual risks, UNKNOWNs.
validation: Docs describe the implemented manifest schema and classification criteria only — no aspirational claims.
Proof artifacts include commands, exit codes, diff scope, residual risks, and UNKNOWNs.
pytest -q tests/coldstart/test_l0_membership.py passes with no fleet running.
Generated artifacts are stable and replayable.
